source_observation: RBI full result for the 2026-10-16 auction; hypothetical noncompetitive allocation at reported competitive weighted-average price, not an investor's actual allotment or fill.
official_method_reference: https://rbi.org.in/scripts/FS_FAQs.aspx?Id=79 (Q24: Government bonds use semiannual coupon frequency and yield formula with r/2; Q25: 30/360 bond-market convention)

method.cashflow_dates: Nominal coupon dates from nominal_cashflows_v1.json; no weekend or public-holiday payment-date adjustment applied.
method.xirr_day_count: Actual calendar days divided by 365; annual-effective rate solved by bisection on the dated nominal cashflows.
method.auction_yield_conversion: Reported annual nominal yield with semiannual compounding converted to effective annual as (1 + y/2)^2 - 1.
method.scope: A cross-convention arithmetic check only. It is not a yield guarantee, achieved investor return, coupon-reinvestment result, forecast, or decision-grade after-tax return. RBI defines YTM with a coupon-reinvestment assumption; realized reinvestment is not modeled here.

limitations: Dirty consideration depends on a conditional 30/360 accrued-interest calculation; the auction notice resolves the cutoff date but settlement rounding/collection was not independently verified.

The reported auction yield and weighted-average clean price are rounded publication values; the comparison mixes the reported auction yield convention with a separately defined actual/365 XIRR convention.
Nominal dates are used; applicable future working-day adjustments and future holidays are not applied.
No investor-specific allotment, transaction fee, coupon tax, coupon reinvestment, future acquisition price, early-exit price, or final investment suitability is qualified.
Do not feed this cross-check into the 2036 portfolio decision, return distribution, covariance, or success-probability calculation.
